ranking.name: Blake Hotel New Orleans, BW Premier Collection

text.text_excerpt: We like to visit New Orleans, and our new discovery is that it is a lot cheaper to stay a few blocks out of the Quarter in the Central Business District. It's a short walk to any attraction in the Vieux Carre, and it is generally a LOT less expensive. This hotel is a real gem in that regard. The beauty of this hotel is that it is right on the St. Charles Streetcar line, and right next door to Lafayette Park. We got in on a Wednesday in time to take in the "Free" concert in the park that night, and all we had to do was cross the street. The Streetcar that runs right in front of the hotel will take you way beyond the Garden District, and bring you back. It is still only $3.00 a day for unli...

Got a swinging deal last minute to stay over night after the Saints opening season game. The Pirate and I found it conveniently located off of Poydras and pulled up to Valet Park our car for our overnight visit. The Valet did mention that if we need our car, it will take about 30 minutes to retrieve it. Got it. Check in took a hot minute and here's the simple reason why. While our hotel did indeed have our room, our reservation through a 3rd party site still had to be typed in. Okay, that's not a problem. Several parties behind us became annoyed, but I wasn't bothered....and they were also waiting for rooms to become available from house keeping. I pretty chill, so I'm good with everythin...

Stayed here one night in this hotel and it is a delightful 8 men at Wok from Bourbon Street. The only downside to this hotel is that they do not have parking on the premises. They do offer valet which I believe is $39 a night so we opted just to park our car and the premiere parking lot across from the hotel for $30 for 24 hours. The check-in was pleasant and quick and the room itself was really nice, no stains or questionable smells in the room! The welcome basket that I received for being a gold member included lots of goodies but the bottled water that came in at is a lifesaver after you spend a night drinking and wake up to hydrated!!!!
